body_html:
PesaCheck was founded with a seed grant from CfA's innovateAFRICA fund in 2017, and continues to be incubated and co-funded through the fund.

PesaCheck has in the past received direct financial support from the International Budget Partnership (IBP) for activities in Kenya, Google's tech-for-good arm Jigsaw for pan-African research and to tackle gender-focused fact-checking, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation (BMGF) for fact-checking health issues, the (now defunct) Data Zetu initiative and Twaweza for activities in Tanzania, and the U.S.-based International Center for Journalists (ICFJ) for activities across East Africa.

We received three project grants from IFCN over the past two years, to support fact-checking on Covid-19 issues and for research into persistent conspiracy claims on YouTube. PesaCheck also carries out paid third-party fact-checking for Meta on Facebook and Instagram, receives support costs from WhatsApp for operating a public tip-line on the platform, and receives occasional ad-hoc travel sponsorships, from organisations such as Access Now, Poynter, and Article 19, for its team to participate in fact-check gatherings.
headline: How We Are Funded
